notes: priors are offline shared models fitted on the TRAIN half only; they are not counted in message bytes
every message byte count = varint length field + range-coded payload (agent mask, float32 poses, body, residual)
sensor height z = W.FLOOR_T + W.SENSOR_HEIGHT is a protocol constant (asserted equal to every generator pose)
decoding = W.observe (memoised exactly, see module docstring) from the decoded float32 poses, joined with the shared map
6.5 KB = 6,500 B; bits_* columns are ideal code lengths per component, bits_coder = 8 x payload bytes - their sum
SYNC tier u re-sends the full exclude-back message every round (rollout_max schedule); an empty tier-c message costs its 1-byte length field

verdict.verdict: PASS (INCOMPLETE PANELS: smoke run, not a verdict)
verdict.best_arm_rule: lowest sum over panel x prior cells of the median per-house collect-distribute (tier c) bytes

definitions.own: median K0 own-map message bytes (tier u: decoded from the own code alone)
definitions.cav: median over directed edges of m(u->v) coded conditioned on the cavity m(v->u) (CAV rows)
definitions.house: median over houses of the total bytes of one collect-distribute fusion, tier c (every directed edge once)
definitions.halves: |A - B| / min(A, B) of each of the three medians, per panel, for the best arm

verdict.reading: PASS -> S0-class exact code locked as the lossless reference line; FAIL_ii -> ~200 B was a small-panel artefact, raise the byte targets before any GPU; INCONCLUSIVE -> a bug (some decode was not voxel-exact), fix before reading any number
